description: Search the catalogue of 296 moving-image works by César Yagüe by free text, collection, resolution, orientation (including ultrawide), colour measured from every frame (a basic colour counts its whole family), price, year, loop length, rotation and availability. A short page brings each work's curatorial capsule. Asking about flashes or epilepsy returns the works with measured abrupt light events.

colour.description: Dominant colour by name (gold, teal, crimson…) or hex. Measured from every frame.

offset.description: Skip this many results, to read the next page

orientation.description: ultrawide = at least twice as wide as tall (21:9 and wider); landscape includes it

query.description: Free text across titles, descriptions and curatorial notes

resolution.description: The resolution label each work shows, matched exactly: HD, 4K, 5K, 8K, 10K, 12K, 16K; square works carry their own, such as 2K or 3K. An unknown label returns the list in use.

rotation.description: Whether the work must keep its orientation or may be rotated 90 degrees

name: search_artworks
title: Search artworks
